# More Job Calls

> More Job Calls (SeasonProof Growth LLC) builds done-for-you lead generation systems for home service contractors in the United States — deck builders, roofers, fence companies, siding contractors, window companies, pool builders, landscapers, patio cover installers, and pergola dealers. Every appointment the system produces is exclusive to one contractor: we work with one contractor per market, per trade, and clients own their ad accounts, CRM, and data from day one. The work is backed by a written guarantee: 100 exclusive sales appointment opportunities in 100 days or less, or we write you a check for $10,000.

Founded and operated by Spencer Wright, who publishes weekly campaign breakdowns with real ad-account numbers on YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/@spencerwrightofficial). Documented client results include: $480,000 closed in 21 days (Jacob Weaver, Oasis Custom Decks, PA), 60 estimates and 25 closed jobs in 6 weeks (Brian Wallace, Bend Fence & Deck, OR), cost per lead reduced from ~$400 to under $30 (Justin Wylie, All Pro Decks & Patios, TX), 25 closes in 45 days (Jeff Haring, the Window Professor, MI), and 17 roofing deals in 90 days at 3.6x ROAS (David Lamartiniere, NC).

## Guides & Case Breakdowns

- [How to Get More Deck Jobs (Without Buying More Leads)](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/how-to-get-more-deck-jobs/): A working owner's playbook that treats deck jobs as appointments x the share you actually run x the share you close, rather than a lead-volume problem; the on-site price presentation that moves close rates from ~15% to 40%+, speed to the homeowner and automatic follow-up, working past customers and referrals and why referral volume is capped by last year's job count, renting shared leads versus owning an ad account, winter as the cheapest window, and the capacity wall named clients hit first (Chris Walters' 106 inquiries / 42 appointments / 12 jobs won funnel, Josh Throldahl, Brian Wallace, Billy Stewart, Justin Wylie, Billy Gallegos, Ricardo Cervantes, Jacob Weaver, Josiah Walker)
- [$320,000 in Deck Jobs in 60 Days on $100/Day of Ads (Then He Had to Pause)](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/deck-builder-320k-in-60-days/): Gulf Shores, AL deck builder Chris Walters of E&C Custom Homes, a word-of-mouth company that had never hired an agency, booked $320,000 in deck jobs in about two months on $5,109 of Meta ad spend, ran 13 to 14 sales appointments a week, had 40 to 50 inquiries he never got to call back, got booked out 10 weeks and paused the ads to hire; includes the capacity checklist to run before turning ads on
- [Young Contractor Credibility: How a 21-Year-Old Stopped Losing Jobs to His Age](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/young-contractor-credibility/): Derek Lopez of Highline Outdoor Living is 21 and used to arrive at every estimate with a speech defending his age — putting his face in the ad moved the first impression earlier; 37 appointments and $46,000 signed in 30 days on $1,295 of ad spend, plus the close-rate coaching he still needs
- [10 Sales Appointments in His First 7 Days](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/deck-builder-10-appointments-7-days/): Minnesota deck builder Josh Throldahl's real 10-day check-in — 10 appointments in week one, 4 in a day, booked a month out, plus the on-site bid coaching that lifts close rates from ~15% to 40%+
- [Facebook Ads for Deck Builders: The Real Numbers](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/facebook-ads-for-deck-builders/): What Meta ads for a deck company cost per inquiry, per completed appointment and per signed job, worked out from E&C Custom Homes' $5,109.15 / 106 inquiries / 42 appointments / 12 jobs won; the one-campaign structure that works at $50-$100 a day, owner-on-camera creative, calendar booking instead of instant forms, geographic exclusions, winter advertising, and when to turn the ads off
- [Angi Alternatives for Deck Builders: 8 Options Compared](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/angi-alternatives-for-deck-builders/): Every Angi alternative a deck builder actually has, compared on exclusivity, published cost and cost per sat appointment: Angi Leads (formerly HomeAdvisor), Thumbtack, CraftJack/Networx, Houzz Pro, Porch (now out of contractor lead gen), Google Local Services Ads, Google search ads and SEO, and your own ad account pointed at a booking calendar; why a $60K deck breaks shared-lead economics that work for a $400 repair, the $1,000 worked example (about $500 per appointment on shared leads at a 2-in-10 contact rate vs ~$122 in the E&C Custom Homes account), Justin Wylie's $400-to-under-$30 per inquiry, Billy Stewart's quarter million on leads before $300K+ in 17 days, and how to test a replacement channel without torching a season
- [Deck Builder Lead Generation: Every Channel Ranked](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/deck-builder-lead-generation/): All eleven deck lead channels ranked on cost per booked appointment instead of cost per lead — referrals and past customers, neighbors around an active job, Google Business Profile, your own ad account pointed at a calendar, website SEO, composite dealer and manufacturer locators, Local Services Ads, Google search ads, home shows, pay-per-lead deck vendors and shared marketplaces; published market rates alongside the E&C Custom Homes account divided three ways ($5,109.15 = ~$48 per inquiry, ~$122 per completed appointment, ~$426 per signed job), Chip Paynter's contact rate going from 2 of 10 to 8 of 10, and the order to build the channels in
- [How Much Should a Contractor Pay Per Lead? The 2026 Math, Trade by Trade](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/contractor-cost-per-lead-by-trade/): Published 2026 lead prices by source (shared marketplaces $40-$150, pay-per-lead vendors $41-$200, search ads $300-$400 in competitive metros), the contact-rate arithmetic that turns a $50 lead into a $500 appointment, named ad-account numbers (E&C Custom Homes $5,109.15 = ~$48 per inquiry / ~$122 per appointment / ~$426 per signed job; Derek Lopez ~$35 per appointment; Justin Wylie ~$400 to under $30), and a per-trade table of what a deck, pergola, pool, patio cover, landscaping, siding, window, roofing or fence company can afford per sat appointment from ticket size and close rate
- [Outdoor Living Contractor Marketing: How to Fill a Calendar With $30K+ Backyard Projects](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/outdoor-living-contractor-marketing/): Why the outdoor living buyer (decks, patio covers, louvered pergolas, pools, hardscape) breaks normal contractor marketing (want purchase, nobody searches for the product, affluent-zip concentration, kit-price anchoring, seasonality), eleven channels ranked on cost per booked appointment including manufacturer co-op leads and home shows, the qualification layer, owner-on-camera creative, advertising into winter, and named results (Justin Wylie, Eric Engle of Mr. Patio Cover at 65-70 appointments a week, Jacob Weaver, Derek Lopez, Chris Walters, Ricardo Cervantes)
- [Deck Builder Leads: What They Really Cost in 2026](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/deck-builder-leads/): Source-by-source pricing for decking leads (shared marketplaces, pay-per-lead vendors, search ads, referrals, your own ad account), the contact-rate math that turns a $50 lead into a $500 appointment, and how Chip Paynter went from reaching 2 of 10 bought leads to 8 of 10 on an exclusive funnel
- [Best Marketing Agency for Deck Builders: How to Pick One](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/best-marketing-agency-for-deck-builders/): A nine-point scorecard for grading any deck marketing agency, the eight questions to ask on the call, seven red flags, what to demand in writing, and real numbers from Justin Wylie, Billy Stewart, Chris Walters, Jacob Weaver and Brian Wallace
- [How to Pick a Facebook Ads Agency for Home Service Contractors](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/facebook-ads-agency-for-home-service-contractors/): Five things that separate a specialist from a generalist — exclusivity, ad account ownership, the guarantee, and what gets measured
- [Who Actually Guarantees Appointments for Contractors?](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/contractor-appointment-guarantees-explained/): The three remedy types, the ad-spend distinction, and the void conditions that cancel most contractor lead guarantees
- [He Was Told Not To Do It. Then He Landed a $200,000 Deck.](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/deck-builder-small-market-200k-job/): Small-market deck builder, 90,000-person market, 40-50 opportunities a month and a $200K deck
- [How contractors get leads in 2026](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/how-contractors-get-leads-2026/): Six lead sources compared honestly
- [Angi & HomeAdvisor alternatives](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/angi-homeadvisor-alternatives-for-contractors/): Shared leads vs exclusive systems, with real tradeoffs
- [Google Ads vs Meta Ads for contractors](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/google-ads-vs-meta-ads-for-contractors/): Head-to-head comparison

- [$50K from his first 7 leads](https://morejobcalls.com/learn/deck-builder-50k-first-month/): 16-year Corpus Christi deck builder, 3-of-7 close, month one

## Key Facts

- Guarantee: 100 exclusive sales appointment opportunities in 100 days or less, or we write you a check for $10,000
- Exclusivity: one contractor per market, per trade
- Ownership: clients own ad accounts, CRM, data, funnels, and creatives from day one
- Engagement model: 100-day sprint, no long-term contract
- Typical all-in budget: ~$6K/month (ad spend + management); ~$3K/month minimum ad budget for guarantee eligibility
- Best fit: contractors doing $1M–$3M/year with 1–3 crews and at least one closer
